title: Beta check: quick skills, warp, overlays, wildlife, leash, co-op
intro: About 5 minutes, seven parts, you set the pace with End. a Fighter main pawn with six skills; player 2's controller connected; start on open ground with no enemies. Things to judge by eye are marked 'Remember'.

steps.text: 1/7 QUICK SKILLS. Open ground, camera facing clear space. Press End (a dummy appears 8 m ahead)
Dummy ahead. Not possessing: press Numpad 1, then 3, then 5 (3 s apart).

expect.label: quick skill used the game's own data
pawn used a skill from the numpad

steps.text: 2/7 WARP. As the Arisen, run 20 m away from your pawns. Then press End
Press Numpad 7 now (pawns should appear next to you). Then Numpad . (heal).

expect.label: Numpad 7 brought the main pawn to you

steps.text: 3/7 OVERLAY. Is the green DPC banner inside the MIDDLE 16:9 of the screen (not at the far left edge)? Remember yes/no. Press End
4/7 WILDLIFE. Walk the pawn near wildlife (deer, birds, a boar) with no enemies around for ~20 s. Does the Arisen shoot at it? Remember. Press End

expect.label: (info) share of time the Arisen was shooting

steps.text: 5/7 LEASH. Auto-warp of the Arisen is OFF for this step.
Press WAIT (so the Arisen stays), then run the pawn straight away from him until 'apart' passes 90 m. Keep going 5 s. Does the game pull the pawn back? Press End

expect.label: pawn got more than 80 m from the Arisen
no script errors far from the Arisen

steps.text: Auto-warp back on (35 m): the Arisen comes to you. Press FOLLOW afterwards.
6/7 CO-OP on the main pawn (player 2's controller)
Player 2: press a few buttons. Are the on-screen prompts still KEYBOARD/MOUSE? Remember.

expect.label: HUD stayed on keyboard/mouse in co-op
co-op L1+R1 = slot 3 (Shield Pummel on the main pawn)
co-op L1+R2 = slot 4 (Launchboard on the main pawn)
no script errors in the whole test

probes.p_sk: local pw = H.pawn(0); local h = pw and pw:call("get_Human"); return h and h:call("get_CustomSkillState")
probes.ppos: local p = H.pawn(0); if not p then return nil end; local v = p:call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); return string.format('%.0f,%.0f,%.0f', v.x, v.y, v.z)
probes.pjump:
local p = H.pawn(0); if not p then return nil end; local v = p:call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position')
local d = PJ and math.sqrt((v.x - PJ.x) ^ 2 + (v.z - PJ.z) ^ 2) or 0; PJ = { x = v.x, z = v.z }; return d
probes.quick: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "DPC_quick.json"); return ok and d and (tostring(d.n) .. " " .. tostring(d.name) .. " " .. tostring(d.result) .. " src=" .. tostring(d.source))
probes.hid: local m = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserInputManager"); return m and m:call("get_HIDInputMode")
probes.brain: local d = H.dpc_brain(); return d and tostring(d.mode)
probes.dpc: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json"); return ok and d and d.info
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json"); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "DPC_coop.json"); return ok and d and d.active == true
